title: OwnFrame vendor
description: Validates one file in data/vendors/: a single in-game vendor — who it is, where to find it, and what it sells at which price. One file per vendor, named <id>.json, so every file maps to one wiki page. A vendor that spends a syndicate's standing points to it via `syndicate`; the syndicate's wiki page then lists these offers. Vendors with live stock in DE's worldState (Baro Ki'Teer, Varzia) get no file — the apps read them, location included, from the worldState. Record facts only (item, price, rank) — no text, descriptions or table layout from other sites (their licenses differ from this repository's CC BY 4.0); name the source in NOTICE.md.

$schema.description: Optional relative path to this schema, for editor autocompletion.

name.description: Vendor name as shown in game (English), e.g. "Cephalon Simaris", "Little Duck".

syndicate.description: id of the file in data/syndicates/ whose standing this vendor's standing prices and rank requirements use. Required as soon as any offer costs standing.

planet.description: Planet or region as named in game (English), e.g. "Venus", "Deimos".

detail.description: Specific place as named in game, e.g. "La Cathédrale". Shown next to the translated hub, so keep it to a name, not a sentence; omit it when the hub says enough.

stock.description: fixed: permanent offers listed here. rotating: changing selection, offers list the whole pool.

item.description: What the vendor hands over (often the blueprint, not the finished item).

itemName.description: Stand-in for item while filling in: the English name as shown in game.

price.description: Every cost paid together for one purchase (e.g. standing plus credits). Omit while unknown — the wiki shows it as missing.

note.description: Short English remark, e.g. "Only during the Plague Star event".

requirement.description: What unlocks the offer. Structured fields first; condition only for what they cannot express.

rank.description: Rank number in the vendor's syndicate (must exist in that syndicate's ranks).

rankTitle.description: Rank title as shown in game (English), e.g. "Agent". Kept until the rank number is known.

quest.description: English name of the quest that must be completed.

questKey.description: uniqueName of that quest's key, when known (lets the apps translate the quest name).

condition.description: Any other English unlock condition, e.g. "Complete the Neptune Junction".
